<function name="StopParticlesWithNameAndAttachment" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Stops all particle effects parented to the entity with given name on given attachment.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The name of the particle to stop.</arg>
		<arg name="attachment" type="number">The attachment of the entity to stop particles on.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
